frames.instruction: Near the top of your page, draw a long rounded head with a blunt left end. Add two small ear bumps along the upper-right edge. Leave the lower-right side open for the body.
frames.visible_job: Near the top of your page, draw a long rounded head with a blunt left end. Add two small ear bumps along the upper-right edge. Leave the lower-right side open for the body.

frames.instruction: Continue the right edge of the head down into a large curved back. Draw two flat oval feet near the bottom and join them with a short belly curve. Leave the front of the body open for the arms.
frames.visible_job: Continue the right edge of the head down into a large curved back. Draw two flat oval feet near the bottom and join them with a short belly curve. Leave the front of the body open for the arms.

frames.instruction: Draw an oval nose near the left end of the muzzle and a short line below it. Add one wide oval eye, one half-closed eye, a small brow over each, and three cheek dots. Extend the lower head line upward into a smile.
frames.visible_job: Draw an oval nose near the left end of the muzzle and a short line below it. Add one wide oval eye, one half-closed eye, a small brow over each, and three cheek dots. Extend the lower head line upward into a smile.

frames.instruction: In the open front of the body, draw two short bent arms ending in rounded paws. Add the small finger curves. Draw a large round orange between the paws, stopping its edge behind each paw and leaving a small gap at the top for its stem. Connect the left paw down toward the left foot.
frames.visible_job: In the open front of the body, draw two short bent arms ending in rounded paws. Add the small finger curves. Draw a large round orange between the paws, stopping its edge behind each paw and leaving a small gap at the top for its stem. Connect the left paw down toward the left foot.

frames.step_name: Add the leaf and small details
frames.instruction: Put a short stem in the gap at the top of the orange, then attach one pointed leaf with a center vein and short side veins. Add four small dimples to the fruit, two toe marks on each foot, and one oval highlight on both the fruit and body.
frames.visible_job: Put a short stem in the gap at the top of the orange, then attach one pointed leaf with a center vein and short side veins. Add four small dimples to the fruit, two toe marks on each foot, and one oval highlight on both the fruit and body.

final_step.instruction: Fill the body warm brown, the fruit orange, and the leaf teal. Color the nose and pupils dark, and add coral inside the ears and on the cheek. Leave the eye whites and both highlight ovals uncolored. Follow the curved shapes with short marker strokes.
final_step.visible_job: Color the existing regions with directional marker strokes while preserving every established contour and white highlight.
adds: brown body, orange fruit, teal leaf, dark nose and pupils, coral ears and cheek

visual_review.first_step_observation: The saved first crop contains a single readable open head outline with two ear bumps and empty paper for the body. No facial ticks or detached body primitives are present.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Reviewed all six saved crops at full size and all five adjacent transitions together. The copy follows head, open body, face, overlapping paws and fruit, details, then one color pass. No landmark disappears or changes attachment. Minor raster contour variation remains; all planned strokes can be continued without silent erasure.

transitions.observed_addition: Both eyes and brows, oval nose with muzzle line, three cheek dots and the extended smiling chin appear; both ears, back, feet and belly remain.
transitions.instruction_match: The instruction names the asymmetric eyes and extends the existing chin into the smile, so facial construction marks never appear and vanish.

transitions.observed_addition: Two bent arms and paws fill the reserved front gap. The orange sits between the paws with its top gap still open; a front body line connects the paw to the foot.
transitions.instruction_match: The instruction draws paws before the orange and reserves the visible top gap; the foreground overlaps add into blank paper.

transitions.observed_addition: The stem and veined leaf fill the reserved fruit gap. Four dimples, both white highlight reservations, and two toe marks per foot appear without removing the paws or face.
transitions.instruction_match: The instruction fills the reserved stem gap and names the leaf, four dimples, toe marks and both highlights visible in the saved crop.

transitions.observed_addition: Brown, orange and teal fills and coral accents appear on the same contours. Both ears, eyes, brows, three cheek dots, paws, feet, stem, leaf, four dimples and two white highlights remain.
